svg.aria-label: Featured projects — Project 01: Technology & AI Investment Strategy. Prioritizes technology initiatives under budget and resource constraints, plans quarterly delivery and tracks realized benefits against targets. Tech: Python, OR-Tools, SQL, Streamlit, Monte Carlo. | Project 02: Commercial Analytics & Pricing Strategy. Explains revenue changes across 1M+ retail transactions, evaluates customer value and identifies data-supported pricing opportunities. Tech: Python, DuckDB, FastAPI, React, TypeScript. | Project 03: Process-to-Value. In development: analyzing procurement event logs to show where workflows stall, loop back into rework and need improvement first. Status: in development. Planned · Python · SQL · PM4Py · BPMN. | Project 04: DoxShield. Investigates data-sovereignty risks by scanning apps, network connections, cookies and permissions, keeping the evidence behind every finding. Tech: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Electron.
